annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five lives outweigh one on paper, and I know that.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have set the handbrake and chocked the wheels before walking away
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think most people's hands would stop there too

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: The numbers matter, and I can't pretend they don't
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: a lookout posted up the line with a radio
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Letting five people die when there's a lever within reach feels wrong

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Part of me reaches for the lever, part of me freezes.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The rail operator installing one would have made this whole choice unnecessary.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: If I pull it, I'm the one who sent the train at my husband.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: even if others see it as a technicality
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The dispatcher should have closed that side track to foot traffic

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: fairness asks me not to count my own person as worth more
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Pulling it feels right, though not easily.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: scheduled that train's move for after the crew cleared out
fitted that track with sensors that sound a horn

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It would be the hardest thing I've ever done
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Somebody should have been sitting in the cab of that train
should have fenced that side track and put up signs

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'd do it slowly and with my heart in my throat
annotations.pda_responsibility: I should have pushed her to use the footbridge instead, and I didn't.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: I should have pushed her to use the footbridge instead

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Loving someone and being fair to strangers pull in opposite directions
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: every worker near a live track should carry a radio
